children.heading_en: Method of Calculating Adjusted Minority Interests, etc. and Adjustment Items
children.summary_ja: 連結子会社の少数株主持分の算入上限、自己保有・意図的保有・少数出資・その他金融機関等が保有する資本調達手段の調整額の算出方法、ならびに特定項目の10%・15%閾値超過額の計算とショート・ポジション相殺・控除・繰延税金資産相殺・AT1・T2資本不足額の算定方法を包括的に規定する条文。
children.summary_en: Comprehensively governs the calculation of minority interest inclusion caps, adjustments for self-held, intentional, minority-invested, and other-FI capital instruments, 10%/15% threshold excess amounts for specified items, short position netting, exclusions, deferred tax asset netting, and AT1/T2 Capital shortfall amounts.

children.heading: 調整後非支配株主持分等の額及び調整項目の額の算出方法
children.text_ja: 第五条第一項第四号、第六条第一項第五号及び第七条第一項第五号に掲げる額は、次に定めるところにより算出した額とする。一第五条第一項第四号に掲げる普通株式等Tier1資本に係る調整後非支配株主持分の額は、特定連結子法人等(連結子法人等(特別目的会社等を除く。以下この条において同じ。)のうち金融機関又はバーゼル銀行監督委員会の定める自己資本比率の基準若しくはこれと類似の基準(法第四十六条の六に定める自己資本規制比率を含む。第三十一条において同じ。)の適用を受ける者をいう。以下この号において同じ。)の非支配株主持分相当普通株式等Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額(特定連結子法人等の単体普通株式等Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額(第二条第一号の算式の分子の額の算出方法における普通株式等Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額又はこれに相当する額をいう。以下この号において同じ。)のうち当該特定連結子法人等の最終指定親会社の連結貸借対照表の純資産の部に株式引受権、新株予約権又は非支配株主持分として計上される部分の額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)をいう。以下この号において同じ。)のうち次に掲げる額のいずれか少ない額に普通株式等Tier1資本に係る第三者持分割合(特定連結子法人等の非支配株主持分相当普通株式等Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額を単体普通株式等Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額で除して得た割合をいう。)を乗じて得た額以下の額とする。イ当該特定連結子法人等の第二条各号の算式の分母の額に相当する額に七パーセントを乗じて得た額ロ第二条各号の算式の分母の額のうち当該特定連結子法人等に関連するものの額(当該特定連結子法人等の同条各号の算式の分母の額に相当する額に関連するものの額をいう。)に七パーセントを乗じて得た額二第六条第一項第五号に掲げるその他Tier1資本に係る調整後非支配株主持分等の額は、連結子法人等の非支配株主持分等相当Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額(連結子法人等の単体Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額(第二条第一号の算式の分子の額の算出方法における普通株式等Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額及び同条第二号の算式の分子の額の算出方法におけるその他Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額の合計額又はこれに相当する額をいう。以下この項において同じ。)のうち当該連結子法人等の最終指定親会社の連結貸借対照表の純資産の部又は負債の部に株式引受権、新株予約権若しくは非支配株主持分又は負債として計上される部分の額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)をいう。以下この号において同じ。)のうち次に掲げる額のいずれか少ない額にTier1資本に係る第三者持分割合(連結子法人等の非支配株主持分等相当Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額を単体Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額で除して得た割合をいう。)を乗じて得た額以下の額から、第五条第一項第四号に掲げる額を控除した額とする。イ当該連結子法人等の第二条各号の算式の分母の額に相当する額に八・五パーセントを乗じて得た額ロ第二条各号の算式の分母の額のうち当該連結子法人等に関連するものの額(当該連結子法人等の同条各号の算式の分母の額に相当する額に関連するものの額をいう。)に八・五パーセントを乗じて得た額三第七条第一項第五号に掲げるTier2資本に係る調整後非支配株主持分等の額は、連結子法人等の非支配株主持分等相当総自己資本に係る基礎項目の額(連結子法人等の単体総自己資本に係る基礎項目の額(連結子法人等の単体Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額及び第二条第三号の算式の分子の額の算出方法におけるTier2資本に係る基礎項目の額の合計額又はこれに相当する額をいう。以下この号において同じ。)のうち当該連結子法人等の最終指定親会社の連結貸借対照表の純資産の部又は負債の部に株式引受権、新株予約権若しくは非支配株主持分又は負債として計上される部分の額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)をいう。以下この号において同じ。)のうち次に掲げる額のいずれか少ない額に総自己資本に係る第三者持分割合(連結子法人等の非支配株主持分等相当総自己資本に係る基礎項目の額を単体総自己資本に係る基礎項目の額で除して得た割合をいう。)を乗じて得た額以下の額から、第五条第一項第四号及び第六条第一項第五号に掲げる額の合計額を控除した額とする。イ当該連結子法人等の第二条各号の算式の分母の額に相当する額に十・五パーセントを乗じて得た額ロ第二条各号の算式の分母の額のうち当該連結子法人等に関連するものの額(当該連結子法人等の同条各号の算式の分母の額に相当する額に関連するものの額をいう。)に十・五パーセントを乗じて得た額
children.text_en: The amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv), Article 6, paragraph (1), item (v), and Article 7, paragraph (1), item (v) shall be calculated as follows. (i) The amount of adjusted minority interests relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the lesser of the following amounts by the third-party interest ratio relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of basic items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital equivalent to minority interests of a specified consolidated subsidiary (meaning a consolidated subsidiary (excluding special purpose companies, etc.; the same applies hereinafter in this Article) that is a financial institution or is subject to capital adequacy ratio standards established by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision or similar standards (including the capital adequacy ratio prescribed in Article 46-6 of the Act; the same applies in Article 31); the same applies hereinafter in this item) by the amount of basic items relating to standalone Common Equity Tier 1 Capital), with such result being the maximum allowable amount: the amount of basic items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital equivalent to minority interests of a specified consolidated subsidiary (meaning the portion of the amount of basic items relating to standalone Common Equity Tier 1 Capital of the specified consolidated subsidiary (meaning the amount of basic items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital in the method for calculating the numerator amount in the formula of Article 2, item (i), or an equivalent amount; the same applies hereinafter in this item) that is recorded in the net assets section of the consolidated balance sheet of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company of such specified consolidated subsidiary as share subscription rights, share options, or non-controlling interests (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero); the same applies hereinafter in this item). (a) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 of such specified consolidated subsidiary by 7%. (b) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount of the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 that is related to such specified consolidated subsidiary (meaning the amount related to the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of such Article of such specified consolidated subsidiary) by 7%. (ii) The amount of adjusted minority interests, etc. relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital set forth in Article 6, paragraph (1), item (v) shall be the amount obtained by deducting the amount set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv) from the amount obtained by multiplying the lesser of the following amounts by the third-party interest ratio relating to Tier 1 Capital (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of basic items relating to Tier 1 Capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary by the amount of basic items relating to standalone Tier 1 Capital), with such result being the maximum allowable amount: the amount of basic items relating to Tier 1 Capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary (meaning the portion of the amount of basic items relating to standalone Tier 1 Capital of the consolidated subsidiary (meaning the total of the amount of basic items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital in the method for calculating the numerator amount in the formula of Article 2, item (i) and the amount of basic items relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital in the method for calculating the numerator amount in the formula of Article 2, item (ii), or an equivalent amount; the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph) that is recorded in the net assets section or liabilities section of the consolidated balance sheet of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company of such consolidated subsidiary as share subscription rights, share options, non-controlling interests, or liabilities (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero); the same applies hereinafter in this item). (a) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 of such consolidated subsidiary by 8.5%. (b) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount of the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 that is related to such consolidated subsidiary (meaning the amount related to the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of such Article of such consolidated subsidiary) by 8.5%. (iii) The amount of adjusted minority interests, etc. relating to Tier 2 Capital set forth in Article 7, paragraph (1), item (v) shall be the amount obtained by deducting the sum of the amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv) and Article 6, paragraph (1), item (v) from the amount obtained by multiplying the lesser of the following amounts by the third-party interest ratio relating to total capital (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of basic items relating to total capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary by the amount of basic items relating to standalone total capital), with such result being the maximum allowable amount: the amount of basic items relating to total capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary (meaning the portion of the amount of basic items relating to standalone total capital of a consolidated subsidiary (meaning the total of the amount of basic items relating to standalone Tier 1 Capital of the consolidated subsidiary and the amount of basic items relating to Tier 2 Capital in the method for calculating the numerator amount in the formula of Article 2, item (iii), or an equivalent amount; the same applies hereinafter in this item) that is recorded in the net assets section or liabilities section of the consolidated balance sheet of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company of such consolidated subsidiary as share subscription rights, share options, non-controlling interests, or liabilities (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero); the same applies hereinafter in this item). (a) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 of such consolidated subsidiary by 10.5%. (b) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount of the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 that is related to such consolidated subsidiary (meaning the amount related to the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of such Article of such consolidated subsidiary) by 10.5%.

clauses_ja.text: 第五条第一項第四号、第六条第一項第五号及び第七条第一項第五号に掲げる額は、次に定めるところにより算出した額とする。

clauses_en.text: The amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv), Article 6, paragraph (1), item (v), and Article 7, paragraph (1), item (v) shall be calculated as follows.

(i) The amount of adjusted minority interests relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the lesser of the following amounts by the third-party interest ratio relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital

(meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of basic items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital equivalent to minority interests of a specified consolidated subsidiary (meaning a consolidated subsidiary (excluding special purpose companies, etc.; the same applies hereinafter in this Article) that is a financial institution or is subject to capital adequacy ratio standards established by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision or similar standards (including the capital adequacy ratio prescribed in Article 46-6 of the Act; the same applies in Article 31); the same applies hereinafter in this item) by the amount of basic items relating to standalone Common Equity Tier 1 Capital)
, with such result being the maximum allowable amount: the amount of basic items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital equivalent to minority interests of a specified consolidated subsidiary

(meaning the portion of the amount of basic items relating to standalone Common Equity Tier 1 Capital of the specified consolidated subsidiary (meaning the amount of basic items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital in the method for calculating the numerator amount in the formula of Article 2, item (i), or an equivalent amount; the same applies hereinafter in this item) that is recorded in the net assets section of the consolidated balance sheet of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company of such specified consolidated subsidiary as share subscription rights, share options, or non-controlling interests (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero); the same applies hereinafter in this item)
(a) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 of such specified consolidated subsidiary by 7%.
(b) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount of the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 that is related to such specified consolidated subsidiary
(meaning the amount related to the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of such Article of such specified consolidated subsidiary)
by 7%.

(ii) The amount of adjusted minority interests, etc. relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital set forth in Article 6, paragraph (1), item (v) shall be the amount obtained by deducting the amount set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv) from the amount obtained by multiplying the lesser of the following amounts by the third-party interest ratio relating to Tier 1 Capital

(meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of basic items relating to Tier 1 Capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary by the amount of basic items relating to standalone Tier 1 Capital)
, with such result being the maximum allowable amount: the amount of basic items relating to Tier 1 Capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary

(meaning the portion of the amount of basic items relating to standalone Tier 1 Capital of the consolidated subsidiary (meaning the total of the amount of basic items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital in the method for calculating the numerator amount in the formula of Article 2, item (i) and the amount of basic items relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital in the method for calculating the numerator amount in the formula of Article 2, item (ii), or an equivalent amount; the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph) that is recorded in the net assets section or liabilities section of the consolidated balance sheet of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company of such consolidated subsidiary as share subscription rights, share options, non-controlling interests, or liabilities (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero); the same applies hereinafter in this item)
(a) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 of such consolidated subsidiary by 8.5%.
(b) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount of the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 that is related to such consolidated subsidiary
(meaning the amount related to the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of such Article of such consolidated subsidiary)

(iii) The amount of adjusted minority interests, etc. relating to Tier 2 Capital set forth in Article 7, paragraph (1), item (v) shall be the amount obtained by deducting the sum of the amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv) and Article 6, paragraph (1), item (v) from the amount obtained by multiplying the lesser of the following amounts by the third-party interest ratio relating to total capital

(meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of basic items relating to total capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary by the amount of basic items relating to standalone total capital)
, with such result being the maximum allowable amount: the amount of basic items relating to total capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary

(meaning the portion of the amount of basic items relating to standalone total capital of a consolidated subsidiary (meaning the total of the amount of basic items relating to standalone Tier 1 Capital of the consolidated subsidiary and the amount of basic items relating to Tier 2 Capital in the method for calculating the numerator amount in the formula of Article 2, item (iii), or an equivalent amount; the same applies hereinafter in this item) that is recorded in the net assets section or liabilities section of the consolidated balance sheet of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company of such consolidated subsidiary as share subscription rights, share options, non-controlling interests, or liabilities (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero); the same applies hereinafter in this item)
(a) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 of such consolidated subsidiary by 10.5%.
(b) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount of the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 that is related to such consolidated subsidiary
(meaning the amount related to the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of such Article of such consolidated subsidiary)

children.text_ja: 前項第二号に定める額を算出する場合において、連結子法人等に当該連結子法人等の子法人等である特別目的会社等があるときは、次に掲げる要件の全てを満たす場合に限り、当該特別目的会社等の発行する資本調達手段の額を、同号のその他Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額に算入することができる。一当該特別目的会社等の発行する資本調達手段がその他Tier1資本調達手段に該当するものであること。二当該特別目的会社等の発行する資本調達手段の発行代り金の全額を当該連結子法人等が即時かつ無制限に利用可能であること。三前号の発行代り金を利用するために発行される資本調達手段がその他Tier1資本調達手段に該当するものであること。四当該連結子法人等が当該特別目的会社等の総株主等の議決権の全てを保有すること。
children.text_en: In calculating the amount provided in item (ii) of the preceding paragraph, where a consolidated subsidiary has a special purpose company, etc. that is a subsidiary of such consolidated subsidiary, the amount of capital instruments issued by such special purpose company, etc. may be included in the amount of basic items relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital under such item only if all of the following requirements are satisfied. (i) That the capital instruments issued by such special purpose company, etc. qualify as Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments. (ii) That the entire proceeds from the issuance of capital instruments issued by such special purpose company, etc. are immediately and unconditionally available to such consolidated subsidiary. (iii) That the capital instruments issued to utilize the proceeds set forth in the preceding item qualify as Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments. (iv) That such consolidated subsidiary holds all of the voting rights of all shareholders, etc. of such special purpose company, etc.

(法人等(会社、組合その他これらに準ずる事業体(外国におけるこれらに相当するものを含む。)をいう。以下同じ。)であって、連結自己資本規制比率の算出に当たり連結の範囲に含まれない者(以下この条において「連結範囲外の法人等」という。)に対する投資その他これに類する行為を通じて実質的に保有している場合に相当すると認められる場合その他これに準ずる場合を含む。)
における当該資本調達手段
(次号及び第三号、次項並びに第十条第二項第六号において「自己保有資本調達手段」という。)
のうち普通株式に該当するものの額とする。
二第六条第二項第一号に掲げる自己保有その他Tier1資本調達手段の額は、自己保有資本調達手段のうちその他Tier1資本調達手段に該当するものの額とする。
三第七条第二項第一号に掲げる自己保有Tier2資本調達手段の額は、自己保有資本調達手段のうちTier2資本調達手段に該当するものの額とする。

(i) The amount of self-held common shares set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (ii) shall be the amount of the capital instruments
(hereinafter referred to as "self-held capital instruments" in items (ii) and (iii), the following paragraph, and Article 10, paragraph (2), item (vi))
of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc.
(excluding those that are treasury shares (meaning treasury shares as provided in Article 2, item (xix) of the Consolidated Financial Statements Regulation))
that qualify as common shares, where the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. holds its own capital instruments

(including cases that are deemed equivalent to constructively holding such instruments through investments or similar acts in juridical persons, etc. (meaning companies, partnerships, and other entities similar thereto (including their foreign equivalents); the same applies hereinafter) that are not included in the scope of consolidation for purposes of calculating the consolidated capital adequacy ratio (hereinafter referred to as "non-consolidated juridical persons, etc." in this Article) and similar cases)

(ii) The amount of self-held Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (i) shall be the amount of self-held capital instruments that qualify as Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments.

(iii) The amount of self-held Tier 2 Capital instruments set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (i) shall be the amount of self-held capital instruments that qualify as Tier 2 Capital instruments.

children.text_ja: 第五条第二項第三号、第六条第二項第二号並びに第七条第二項第二号及び第三項第一号に掲げる額は、次に定めるところにより算出した額とする。一第五条第二項第三号に掲げる意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の普通株式の額は、最終指定親会社等が金融機関若しくはこれに準ずる外国の者又は金融業、保険業その他の業種に属する事業を主たる事業として営む者(これに準ずる外国の者を含み、金融システムに影響を及ぼすおそれがないと認められる者その他の者を除く。)であって、連結自己資本規制比率の算出に当たり連結の範囲に含まれないもの(以下この章において「他の金融機関等」という。)との間で相互に自己資本規制比率(法第四十六条の六に規定する自己資本規制比率をいう。以下この号において同じ。)(TLAC規制対象会社又はその連結子法人等にあっては、自己資本規制比率又は外部TLAC比率(最終指定親会社TLAC告示第二条第一項に規定する外部TLAC比率をいう。))若しくはこれと類似の比率を向上させるため、意図的に当該他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段(対象資本調達手段(資本調達手段のうち、普通株式に相当するもの(みなし普通株式(普通株式、その他Tier1資本調達手段又はTier2資本調達手段のいずれにも相当しない資本調達手段をいう。)を含む。以下この条において同じ。)、その他Tier1資本調達手段に相当するもの又はTier2資本調達手段に相当するもの(規制金融機関の資本調達手段にあっては、当該規制金融機関に適用される経営の健全性を判断するための基準又はこれと類似の基準において連結自己資本規制比率の算式の分子の額を構成するものに相当するものに限る。)をいう。)又はその他外部TLAC関連調達手段をいう。以下この条及び第十条第二項第六号において同じ。)を保有していると認められ、かつ、当該他の金融機関等が意図的に当該最終指定親会社等の普通株式、その他Tier1資本調達手段、Tier2資本調達手段又はその他外部TLAC関連調達手段を保有していると認められる場合(最終指定親会社等又は他の金融機関等が連結範囲外の法人等に対する投資その他これに類する行為を通じて実質的に保有している場合に相当すると認められる場合その他これに準ずる場合を含む。)における当該他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段(以下この項において「意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段」という。)のうち普通株式に相当するものの額とする。二第六条第二項第二号に掲げる意図的に保有している他の金融機関等のその他Tier1資本調達手段の額は、意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうちその他Tier1資本調達手段に相当するものの額とする。三第七条第二項第二号に掲げる意図的に保有している他の金融機関等のTier2資本調達手段の額は、意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうちTier2資本調達手段に相当するものの額とする。四第七条第三項第一号に掲げる意図的に保有している他の金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額は、意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうちその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額とする。
children.text_en: The amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (iii), Article 6, paragraph (2), item (ii), and Article 7, paragraph (2), item (ii) and paragraph (3), item (i) shall be calculated as follows. (i) The amount of common shares of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (iii) shall be the amount equivalent to common shares of the target capital, etc. instruments (hereinafter referred to as "target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally" in this paragraph) of other financial institutions, etc. (meaning financial institutions or their foreign equivalents, or persons whose principal business is in the financial, insurance, or other sectors (including their foreign equivalents, but excluding those deemed to have no risk of affecting the financial system and others); the same applies hereinafter in this Chapter) that are not included in the scope of consolidation for purposes of calculating the consolidated capital adequacy ratio, in cases where the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. is deemed to intentionally hold the target capital, etc. instruments (meaning target capital instruments (meaning capital instruments equivalent to common shares (including deemed common shares (meaning capital instruments equivalent to none of common shares, Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments, or Tier 2 Capital instruments)), instruments equivalent to Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments, or instruments equivalent to Tier 2 Capital instruments (in the case of capital instruments of regulated financial institutions, limited to those equivalent to instruments constituting the numerator of the consolidated capital adequacy ratio formula under the standards applicable to such regulated financial institutions or similar standards)) or other external TLAC-related instruments; the same applies hereinafter in this Article and Article 10, paragraph (2), item (vi)) of such other financial institutions, etc. in order to mutually improve the capital adequacy ratio (meaning the capital adequacy ratio as provided in Article 46-6 of the Act; the same applies hereinafter in this item) (in the case of TLAC-regulated companies or their consolidated subsidiaries, the capital adequacy ratio or the external TLAC ratio (meaning the external TLAC ratio as provided in Article 2, paragraph (1) of the TLAC Public Notice for Ultimate Designated Parent Companies)) or similar ratios with such other financial institutions, etc., and where such other financial institutions, etc. are deemed to intentionally hold common shares, Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments, Tier 2 Capital instruments, or other external TLAC-related instruments of such Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. (including cases deemed equivalent to constructive holding through investments or similar acts in non-consolidated juridical persons, etc. by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. or other financial institutions, etc., and similar cases). (ii) The amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (ii) shall be the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally that are equivalent to Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments. (iii) The amount of Tier 2 Capital instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (ii) shall be the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally that are equivalent to Tier 2 Capital instruments. (iv) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally set forth in Article 7, paragraph (3), item (i) shall be the amount of other external TLAC-related instruments among the target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally.

clauses_ja.text: 第五条第二項第三号、第六条第二項第二号並びに第七条第二項第二号及び第三項第一号に掲げる額は、次に定めるところにより算出した額とする。
一第五条第二項第三号に掲げる意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の普通株式の額は、最終指定親会社等が金融機関若しくはこれに準ずる外国の者又は金融業、保険業その他の業種に属する事業を主たる事業として営む者
(これに準ずる外国の者を含み、金融システムに影響を及ぼすおそれがないと認められる者その他の者を除く。)
であって、連結自己資本規制比率の算出に当たり連結の範囲に含まれないもの
(以下この章において「他の金融機関等」という。)
との間で相互に自己資本規制比率
(法第四十六条の六に規定する自己資本規制比率をいう。以下この号において同じ。)
(TLAC規制対象会社又はその連結子法人等にあっては、自己資本規制比率又は外部TLAC比率(最終指定親会社TLAC告示第二条第一項に規定する外部TLAC比率をいう。))
若しくはこれと類似の比率を向上させるため、意図的に当該他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段

(対象資本調達手段(資本調達手段のうち、普通株式に相当するもの(みなし普通株式(普通株式、その他Tier1資本調達手段又はTier2資本調達手段のいずれにも相当しない資本調達手段をいう。)を含む。以下この条において同じ。)、その他Tier1資本調達手段に相当するもの又はTier2資本調達手段に相当するもの(規制金融機関の資本調達手段にあっては、当該規制金融機関に適用される経営の健全性を判断するための基準又はこれと類似の基準において連結自己資本規制比率の算式の分子の額を構成するものに相当するものに限る。)をいう。)又はその他外部TLAC関連調達手段をいう。以下この条及び第十条第二項第六号において同じ。)
を保有していると認められ、かつ、当該他の金融機関等が意図的に当該最終指定親会社等の普通株式、その他Tier1資本調達手段、Tier2資本調達手段又はその他外部TLAC関連調達手段を保有していると認められる場合
(最終指定親会社等又は他の金融機関等が連結範囲外の法人等に対する投資その他これに類する行為を通じて実質的に保有している場合に相当すると認められる場合その他これに準ずる場合を含む。)
における当該他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段
(以下この項において「意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段」という。)
のうち普通株式に相当するものの額とする。
二第六条第二項第二号に掲げる意図的に保有している他の金融機関等のその他Tier1資本調達手段の額は、意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうちその他Tier1資本調達手段に相当するものの額とする。
三第七条第二項第二号に掲げる意図的に保有している他の金融機関等のTier2資本調達手段の額は、意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうちTier2資本調達手段に相当するものの額とする。
四第七条第三項第一号に掲げる意図的に保有している他の金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額は、意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうちその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額とする。

clauses_en.text: The amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (iii), Article 6, paragraph (2), item (ii), and Article 7, paragraph (2), item (ii) and paragraph (3), item (i) shall be calculated as follows.

(i) The amount of common shares of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (iii) shall be the amount equivalent to common shares of the target capital, etc. instruments
(hereinafter referred to as "target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally" in this paragraph)
of other financial institutions, etc.

(meaning financial institutions or their foreign equivalents, or persons whose principal business is in the financial, insurance, or other sectors (including their foreign equivalents, but excluding those deemed to have no risk of affecting the financial system and others); the same applies hereinafter in this Chapter)

that are not included in the scope of consolidation for purposes of calculating the consolidated capital adequacy ratio, in cases where the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. is deemed to intentionally hold the target capital, etc. instruments

(meaning target capital instruments (meaning capital instruments equivalent to common shares (including deemed common shares (meaning capital instruments equivalent to none of common shares, Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments, or Tier 2 Capital instruments)), instruments equivalent to Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments, or instruments equivalent to Tier 2 Capital instruments (in the case of capital instruments of regulated financial institutions, limited to those equivalent to instruments constituting the numerator of the consolidated capital adequacy ratio formula under the standards applicable to such regulated financial institutions or similar standards)) or other external TLAC-related instruments; the same applies hereinafter in this Article and Article 10, paragraph (2), item (vi))
of such other financial institutions, etc. in order to mutually improve the capital adequacy ratio
(meaning the capital adequacy ratio as provided in Article 46-6 of the Act; the same applies hereinafter in this item)

(in the case of TLAC-regulated companies or their consolidated subsidiaries, the capital adequacy ratio or the external TLAC ratio (meaning the external TLAC ratio as provided in Article 2, paragraph (1) of the TLAC Public Notice for Ultimate Designated Parent Companies))

or similar ratios with such other financial institutions, etc., and where such other financial institutions, etc. are deemed to intentionally hold common shares, Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments, Tier 2 Capital instruments, or other external TLAC-related instruments of such Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc.

(including cases deemed equivalent to constructive holding through investments or similar acts in non-consolidated juridical persons, etc. by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. or other financial institutions, etc., and similar cases)

(ii) The amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (ii) shall be the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally that are equivalent to Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments.

(iii) The amount of Tier 2 Capital instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (ii) shall be the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally that are equivalent to Tier 2 Capital instruments.

children.text_ja: 第五条第二項第四号、第六条第二項第三号並びに第七条第二項第三号及び第五号に掲げる額は、次に定めるところにより算出した額とする。一第五条第二項第四号に掲げる少数出資金融機関等の普通株式の額は、少数出資調整対象額(少数出資金融機関等(最終指定親会社等がその総株主等の議決権の百分の十を超える議決権を保有していない他の金融機関等をいう。以下この項及び第十一項において同じ。)の対象資本等調達手段を最終指定親会社等が保有している場合(連結範囲外の法人等に対する投資その他これに類する行為を通じて当該最終指定親会社等が実質的に保有している場合に相当すると認められる場合その他これに準ずる場合を含み、前項各号の場合を除く。)における当該対象資本等調達手段の額(その他外部TLAC関連調達手段にあっては、その他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額の合計額(当該額を算出する場合においては、第十一項の規定にかかわらず、最終指定親会社等が少数出資金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段に係る一定のショート・ポジションを保有するときであっても、これらのその他外部TLAC関連調達手段と対応するショート・ポジションを相殺することはできないものとする。)から少数出資に係る五パーセント基準額(第五条第一項各号に掲げる額の合計額から同条第二項第一号から第三号までに掲げる額の合計額を控除した額に五パーセントを乗じて得た額をいう。)を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合には、零とし、TLAC規制対象最終指定親会社にあっては、当該最終指定親会社等が保有しているその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額の合計額からマーケット・メイク目的保有TLACの額の合計額を控除した額とする。第四号において「基準超過その他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額」という。)とする。)の合計額(以下この項において「少数出資に係る対象資本等調達手段合計額」という。)から少数出資に係る十パーセント基準額(同条第一項各号に掲げる額の合計額から同条第二項第一号から第三号までに掲げる額の合計額を控除した額に十パーセントを乗じて得た額をいう。)を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合には、零とする。)をいう。以下この項において同じ。)に少数出資に係る普通株式保有割合(少数出資金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうち普通株式に相当するものの額を少数出資に係る対象資本等調達手段合計額で除して得た割合をいう。)を乗じて得た額とする。二第六条第二項第三号に掲げる少数出資金融機関等のその他Tier1資本調達手段の額は、少数出資調整対象額に少数出資に係るその他Tier1資本保有割合(少数出資金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうちその他Tier1資本調達手段に相当するものの額を少数出資に係る対象資本等調達手段合計額で除して得た割合をいう。)を乗じて得た額とする。三第七条第二項第三号に掲げる少数出資金融機関等のTier2資本調達手段の額は、少数出資調整対象額に少数出資に係るTier2資本保有割合(少数出資金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうちTier2資本調達手段に相当するものの額を少数出資に係る対象資本等調達手段合計額で除して得た割合をいう。)を乗じて得た額とする。四第七条第二項第五号に掲げる少数出資金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額は、少数出資調整対象額に少数出資に係るその他外部TLAC保有割合(少数出資金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうち基準超過その他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額を少数出資に係る対象資本等調達手段合計額で除して得た割合をいう。)を乗じて得た額とする。
children.text_en: The amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (iv), Article 6, paragraph (2), item (iii), and Article 7, paragraph (2), items (iii) and (v) shall be calculated as follows. (i) The amount of common shares of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (iv) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the minority investment adjustment amount (meaning the amount obtained by deducting the 10% threshold amount relating to minority investments (meaning the amount obtained by multiplying by 10% the amount obtained by deducting the sum of the amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), items (i) through (iii) from the sum of the amounts set forth in each item of Article 5, paragraph (1)) from the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments (hereinafter referred to as the "total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments" in this paragraph) (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero); the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph) — being the total of the amounts of target capital, etc. instruments held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. in minority-invested financial institutions, etc. (meaning other financial institutions, etc. in which the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. does not hold more than 10% of the total voting rights of all shareholders, etc.; the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph and paragraph (11)) (including cases deemed equivalent to constructive holding through investments in non-consolidated juridical persons, etc., but excluding cases falling under each item of the preceding paragraph), where the amount for other external TLAC-related instruments is the total amount of such instruments (provided that, in calculating such amount, notwithstanding paragraph (11), corresponding short positions may not be offset even if the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. holds certain short positions relating to such instruments) minus the 5% threshold amount relating to minority investments (meaning 5% of the amount obtained by deducting the sum of the amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), items (i) through (iii) from the sum of the amounts set forth in each item of Article 5, paragraph (1)) (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero, and for a TLAC-regulated Ultimate Designated Parent Company, it shall be the total amount of other external TLAC-related instruments held by such Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. minus the total amount of market-making TLAC; hereinafter referred to as the "above-threshold other external TLAC-related instruments amount" in item (iv)) — by the common share holding ratio relating to minority investments (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. that are equivalent to common shares by the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments). (ii) The amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (iii) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the minority investment adjustment amount by the Additional Tier 1 Capital holding ratio relating to minority investments (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. that are equivalent to Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments by the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments). (iii) The amount of Tier 2 Capital instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (iii) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the minority investment adjustment amount by the Tier 2 Capital holding ratio relating to minority investments (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. that are equivalent to Tier 2 Capital instruments by the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments). (iv) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (v) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the minority investment adjustment amount by the other external TLAC holding ratio relating to minority investments (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the above-threshold other external TLAC-related instruments amount of target capital, etc. instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. by the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments).

一第五条第二項第四号に掲げる少数出資金融機関等の普通株式の額は、少数出資調整対象額

(少数出資金融機関等(最終指定親会社等がその総株主等の議決権の百分の十を超える議決権を保有していない他の金融機関等をいう。以下この項及び第十一項において同じ。)の対象資本等調達手段を最終指定親会社等が保有している場合(連結範囲外の法人等に対する投資その他これに類する行為を通じて当該最終指定親会社等が実質的に保有している場合に相当すると認められる場合その他これに準ずる場合を含み、前項各号の場合を除く。)における当該対象資本等調達手段の額(その他外部TLAC関連調達手段にあっては、その他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額の合計額(当該額を算出する場合においては、第十一項の規定にかかわらず、最終指定親会社等が少数出資金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段に係る一定のショート・ポジションを保有するときであっても、これらのその他外部TLAC関連調達手段と対応するショート・ポジションを相殺することはできないものとする。)から少数出資に係る五パーセント基準額(第五条第一項各号に掲げる額の合計額から同条第二項第一号から第三号までに掲げる額の合計額を控除した額に五パーセントを乗じて得た額をいう。)を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合には、零とし、TLAC規制対象最終指定親会社にあっては、当該最終指定親会社等が保有しているその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額の合計額からマーケット・メイク目的保有TLACの額の合計額を控除した額とする。第四号において「基準超過その他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額」という。)とする。)の合計額(以下この項において「少数出資に係る対象資本等調達手段合計額」という。)から少数出資に係る十パーセント基準額(同条第一項各号に掲げる額の合計額から同条第二項第一号から第三号までに掲げる額の合計額を控除した額に十パーセントを乗じて得た額をいう。)を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合には、零とする。)をいう。以下この項において同じ。)
に少数出資に係る普通株式保有割合
(少数出資金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうち普通株式に相当するものの額を少数出資に係る対象資本等調達手段合計額で除して得た割合をいう。)
を乗じて得た額とする。
二第六条第二項第三号に掲げる少数出資金融機関等のその他Tier1資本調達手段の額は、少数出資調整対象額に少数出資に係るその他Tier1資本保有割合
(少数出資金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうちその他Tier1資本調達手段に相当するものの額を少数出資に係る対象資本等調達手段合計額で除して得た割合をいう。)
を乗じて得た額とする。
三第七条第二項第三号に掲げる少数出資金融機関等のTier2資本調達手段の額は、少数出資調整対象額に少数出資に係るTier2資本保有割合
(少数出資金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうちTier2資本調達手段に相当するものの額を少数出資に係る対象資本等調達手段合計額で除して得た割合をいう。)
を乗じて得た額とする。
四第七条第二項第五号に掲げる少数出資金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額は、少数出資調整対象額に少数出資に係るその他外部TLAC保有割合
(少数出資金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうち基準超過その他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額を少数出資に係る対象資本等調達手段合計額で除して得た割合をいう。)
を乗じて得た額とする。

(meaning the amount obtained by deducting the 10% threshold amount relating to minority investments (meaning the amount obtained by multiplying by 10% the amount obtained by deducting the sum of the amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), items (i) through (iii) from the sum of the amounts set forth in each item of Article 5, paragraph (1)) from the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments (hereinafter referred to as the "total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments" in this paragraph) (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero); the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph)

(meaning other financial institutions, etc. in which the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. does not hold more than 10% of the total voting rights of all shareholders, etc.; the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph and paragraph (11))
(including cases deemed equivalent to constructive holding through investments in non-consolidated juridical persons, etc., but excluding cases falling under each item of the preceding paragraph)

minus the 5% threshold amount relating to minority investments

— by the common share holding ratio relating to minority investments

(meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. that are equivalent to common shares by the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments)

(ii) The amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (iii) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the minority investment adjustment amount by the Additional Tier 1 Capital holding ratio relating to minority investments

(meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. that are equivalent to Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments by the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments)

(iii) The amount of Tier 2 Capital instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (iii) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the minority investment adjustment amount by the Tier 2 Capital holding ratio relating to minority investments

(meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. that are equivalent to Tier 2 Capital instruments by the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments)

(iv) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (v) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the minority investment adjustment amount by the other external TLAC holding ratio relating to minority investments

(meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the above-threshold other external TLAC-related instruments amount of target capital, etc. instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. by the total amount of target capital, etc. instruments relating to minority investments)

children.text_ja: 第六条第二項第四号並びに第七条第二項第四号及び第六号に掲げる額は、次に定めるところにより算出した額とする。一第六条第二項第四号に掲げるその他金融機関等のその他Tier1資本調達手段の額は、その他金融機関等(次に掲げる者をいう。)の対象資本等調達手段を最終指定親会社等が保有している場合(連結範囲外の法人等に対する投資その他これに類する行為を通じて当該最終指定親会社等が実質的に保有している場合に相当すると認められる場合その他これに準ずる場合を含み、第六項各号の場合を除く。)における当該対象資本等調達手段(以下この条において「その他金融機関等に係る対象資本等調達手段」という。)のうちその他Tier1資本調達手段に相当するものの額とする。イ当該最終指定親会社等がその総株主等の議決権の百分の十を超える議決権を保有している他の金融機関等ロ連結財務諸表規則第五条第一項各号に該当するため、連結自己資本規制比率の算出に当たり連結の範囲に含まれない金融子会社(イに掲げる者を除く。)ハ当該最終指定親会社が銀行又は銀行法第五十二条の二十三第一項第一号から第十号まで若しくは第十五号に掲げる会社(同項第十号に掲げる会社のうち同号イに掲げる業務を専ら営むものを除く。以下この号において「金融業務を営む会社」という。)を子会社等としている場合における当該子会社等であって、連結財務諸表規則第五条第一項各号又は第二項に該当するため、連結自己資本規制比率の算出に当たり連結の範囲に含まれないもの(イ及びロに掲げる者を除く。)ニ当該最終指定親会社が金融業務を営む会社を関連会社等としている場合における当該関連会社等(次条において「金融業務を営む関連会社等」という。)(イに掲げる者を除く。)二第七条第二項第四号に掲げるその他金融機関等のTier2資本調達手段の額は、その他金融機関等に係る対象資本等調達手段のうちTier2資本調達手段に相当するものの額とする。三第七条第二項第六号に掲げるその他金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額は、その他金融機関等に係る対象資本等調達手段のうちその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額とする。
children.text_en: The amounts set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (iv) and Article 7, paragraph (2), items (iv) and (vi) shall be calculated as follows. (i) The amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments of other financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (iv) shall be the amount of target capital, etc. instruments (hereinafter referred to as "target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc." in this Article) of other financial institutions, etc. (meaning the following persons) held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. (including cases deemed equivalent to constructive holding through investments in non-consolidated juridical persons, etc., but excluding cases falling under each item of paragraph (6)) that are equivalent to Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments. (a) Other financial institutions, etc. in which the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. holds more than 10% of the total voting rights of all shareholders, etc. (b) Financial subsidiaries not included in the scope of consolidation because they fall under each item of Article 5, paragraph (1) of the Consolidated Financial Statements Regulation (excluding those set forth in (a)). (c) Subsidiaries, etc. of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company that are banks or companies set forth in Article 52-23, paragraph (1), items (i) through (x) or item (xv) of the Banking Act (excluding companies set forth in item (x) of such paragraph that exclusively engage in the business set forth in item (a) thereof; hereinafter referred to as "companies engaged in financial business" in this item) that are not included in the scope of consolidation because they fall under each item or paragraph (2) of Article 5, paragraph (1) of the Consolidated Financial Statements Regulation (excluding those set forth in (a) and (b)). (d) Affiliated companies, etc. of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company that are companies engaged in financial business (hereinafter referred to as "affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business" in the following Article) (excluding those set forth in (a)). (ii) The amount of Tier 2 Capital instruments of other financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (iv) shall be the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc. that are equivalent to Tier 2 Capital instruments. (iii) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of other financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (vi) shall be the amount of other external TLAC-related instruments among the target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc.

clauses_ja.text: 第六条第二項第四号並びに第七条第二項第四号及び第六号に掲げる額は、次に定めるところにより算出した額とする。
一第六条第二項第四号に掲げるその他金融機関等のその他Tier1資本調達手段の額は、その他金融機関等
(次に掲げる者をいう。)
の対象資本等調達手段を最終指定親会社等が保有している場合
(連結範囲外の法人等に対する投資その他これに類する行為を通じて当該最終指定親会社等が実質的に保有している場合に相当すると認められる場合その他これに準ずる場合を含み、第六項各号の場合を除く。)
における当該対象資本等調達手段
(以下この条において「その他金融機関等に係る対象資本等調達手段」という。)
のうちその他Tier1資本調達手段に相当するものの額とする。

clauses_en.text: The amounts set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (iv) and Article 7, paragraph (2), items (iv) and (vi) shall be calculated as follows.
(i) The amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments of other financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (iv) shall be the amount of target capital, etc. instruments
(hereinafter referred to as "target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc." in this Article)
of other financial institutions, etc.
(meaning the following persons)
held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc.
(including cases deemed equivalent to constructive holding through investments in non-consolidated juridical persons, etc., but excluding cases falling under each item of paragraph (6))
that are equivalent to Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments.
(a) Other financial institutions, etc. in which the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. holds more than 10% of the total voting rights of all shareholders, etc.
(b) Financial subsidiaries not included in the scope of consolidation because they fall under each item of Article 5, paragraph (1) of the Consolidated Financial Statements Regulation
(excluding those set forth in (a))
(c) Subsidiaries, etc. of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company that are banks or companies set forth in Article 52-23, paragraph (1), items (i) through (x) or item (xv) of the Banking Act

(excluding companies set forth in item (x) of such paragraph that exclusively engage in the business set forth in item (a) thereof; hereinafter referred to as "companies engaged in financial business" in this item)
that are not included in the scope of consolidation because they fall under each item or paragraph (2) of Article 5, paragraph (1) of the Consolidated Financial Statements Regulation
(excluding those set forth in (a) and (b))
(d) Affiliated companies, etc. of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company that are companies engaged in financial business
(hereinafter referred to as "affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business" in the following Article)
(excluding those set forth in (a))

(ii) The amount of Tier 2 Capital instruments of other financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (iv) shall be the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc. that are equivalent to Tier 2 Capital instruments.

(iii) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of other financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (vi) shall be the amount of other external TLAC-related instruments among the target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc.

children.text_en: In calculating the amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (i)(b) and paragraph (9), item (iii) and each item of paragraph (10), where there is an amount of deferred tax assets and an amount of deferred tax liabilities related thereto (excluding amounts offset pursuant to the provisions of Article 5, paragraph (4); the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph), the amount of each category of deferred tax assets set forth in each of the following items may be offset against the amount defined in each such item. children.text_ja: 第五条第二項第七号及び第六条第二項第五号に掲げる額は、次に定めるところにより算出した額とする。一第五条第二項第七号に掲げるその他Tier1資本不足額は、第二条第二号の算式におけるその他Tier1資本に係る調整項目の額からその他Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)とする。二第六条第二項第五号に掲げるTier2資本不足額は、第二条第三号の算式におけるTier2資本に係る調整項目の額からTier2資本に係る基礎項目の額を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)とする。
children.text_en: The amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (vii) and Article 6, paragraph (2), item (v) shall be calculated as follows. (i) The Additional Tier 1 Capital shortfall amount set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (vii) shall be the amount obtained by deducting the amount of basic items relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital from the amount of adjustment items relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (ii) (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero). (ii) The Tier 2 Capital shortfall amount set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (v) shall be the amount obtained by deducting the amount of basic items relating to Tier 2 Capital from the amount of adjustment items relating to Tier 2 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (iii) (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero).

clauses_ja.text: 第五条第二項第七号及び第六条第二項第五号に掲げる額は、次に定めるところにより算出した額とする。
一第五条第二項第七号に掲げるその他Tier1資本不足額は、第二条第二号の算式におけるその他Tier1資本に係る調整項目の額からその他Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額を控除した額
(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)
とする。
二第六条第二項第五号に掲げるTier2資本不足額は、第二条第三号の算式におけるTier2資本に係る調整項目の額からTier2資本に係る基礎項目の額を控除した額
(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)
とする。

clauses_en.text: The amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (vii) and Article 6, paragraph (2), item (v) shall be calculated as follows.

(i) The Additional Tier 1 Capital shortfall amount set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (vii) shall be the amount obtained by deducting the amount of basic items relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital from the amount of adjustment items relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (ii)
(where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero)

(ii) The Tier 2 Capital shortfall amount set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (v) shall be the amount obtained by deducting the amount of basic items relating to Tier 2 Capital from the amount of adjustment items relating to Tier 2 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (iii)
(where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero)

children.heading: 比例連結
children.summary_ja: 一定の要件を満たす金融業務を営む関連会社等について、少数出資の調整や自己保有調整の代わりに比例連結方式で連結自己資本規制比率を算出することを認め、一度採用したら原則継続する旨を定める条文。
children.summary_en: Permits proportional consolidation of affiliated companies engaged in financial business that meet specified joint-control requirements as an alternative to minority-investment and self-holding deductions, and requires continued use once adopted.

children.text_ja: 金融業務を営む関連会社等(保険会社等を除く。以下この条において同じ。)について、次に掲げる要件の全てを満たす場合には、第五条第二項、前条第六項から第十二項まで及び次条第二項の規定にかかわらず、第二条各号及び第二条の二第一項の算式において当該金融業務を営む関連会社等を比例連結の方法(会社の資産、負債、収益及び費用のうち当該会社に投資している最終指定親会社等に帰属する部分を連結の範囲に含める方法をいう。次項において同じ。)により連結の範囲に含めて連結自己資本規制比率を算出することができる。この場合においては、当該金融業務を営む関連会社等に対する投資については、連結財務諸表規則第十条第一項本文の規定にかかわらず、持分法を適用しないものとし、当該金融業務を営む関連会社等は連結子法人等とみなす。一当該金融業務を営む関連会社等に投資を行う二以上の法人等(以下この項において「共同支配会社」という。)が共同でその事業の支配を行うために投資及び事業に関する契約を締結していること。二共同支配会社が前号に規定する投資及び事業に関する契約に基づき、当該共同支配会社の当該金融業務を営む関連会社等に対する保有議決権割合に応じて共同でその事業の支配及び運営を行っていること。三共同支配会社の当該金融業務を営む関連会社等に対する保有議決権割合がいずれも百分の二十以上であること。四当該金融業務を営む関連会社等を関連会社等とする最終指定親会社が当該最終指定親会社の当該金融業務を営む関連会社等に対する保有議決権割合を超えてその事業に関して責任を負うべきことを約する契約その他これに類するものがないこと。
children.text_en: Where all of the following requirements are satisfied for affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business (excluding insurance companies, etc.; the same applies hereinafter in this Article), notwithstanding the provisions of Article 5, paragraph (2), each item of paragraph (6) through paragraph (12) of the preceding Article, and Article 10, paragraph (2), the consolidated capital adequacy ratio may be calculated by including such affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business in the scope of consolidation in the formula of each item of Article 2 and Article 2-2, paragraph (1), using the proportional consolidation method (meaning a method of including in the scope of consolidation the portion of a company's assets, liabilities, revenues and expenses attributable to the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. investing in such company; the same applies in the following paragraph). In such case, the equity method shall not be applied to investments in such affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business, notwithstanding the provisions of the main text of Article 10, paragraph (1) of the Consolidated Financial Statements Regulation, and such affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business shall be deemed consolidated subsidiaries, etc. (i) Two or more juridical persons, etc. investing in such affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business (hereinafter referred to as "jointly controlled companies" in this paragraph) have concluded investment and business agreements for the purpose of jointly controlling the business of such affiliated companies, etc. (ii) The jointly controlled companies are jointly controlling and operating the business of such affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business in proportion to their voting rights holding ratio with respect to such affiliated companies, etc., based on the investment and business agreements provided in item (i). (iii) The voting rights holding ratio of each of the jointly controlled companies with respect to such affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business is not less than 20%. (iv) There is no contract or similar agreement in which the Ultimate Designated Parent Company having such affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business as affiliated companies, etc. agrees to be responsible for the business of such affiliated companies, etc. beyond the Ultimate Designated Parent Company's voting rights holding ratio with respect to such affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business.

clauses_ja.text: 金融業務を営む関連会社等
(保険会社等を除く。以下この条において同じ。)
について、次に掲げる要件の全てを満たす場合には、第五条第二項、前条第六項から第十二項まで及び次条第二項の規定にかかわらず、
第二条各号及び第二条の二第一項の算式において当該金融業務を営む関連会社等を比例連結の方法
(会社の資産、負債、収益及び費用のうち当該会社に投資している最終指定親会社等に帰属する部分を連結の範囲に含める方法をいう。次項において同じ。)
により連結の範囲に含めて連結自己資本規制比率を算出することができる。
この場合においては、当該金融業務を営む関連会社等に対する投資については、連結財務諸表規則第十条第一項本文の規定にかかわらず、持分法を適用しないものとし、当該金融業務を営む関連会社等は連結子法人等とみなす。
一当該金融業務を営む関連会社等に投資を行う二以上の法人等
(以下この項において「共同支配会社」という。)
が共同でその事業の支配を行うために投資及び事業に関する契約を締結していること。
二共同支配会社が前号に規定する投資及び事業に関する契約に基づき、当該共同支配会社の当該金融業務を営む関連会社等に対する保有議決権割合に応じて共同でその事業の支配及び運営を行っていること。
三共同支配会社の当該金融業務を営む関連会社等に対する保有議決権割合がいずれも百分の二十以上であること。
四当該金融業務を営む関連会社等を関連会社等とする最終指定親会社が当該最終指定親会社の当該金融業務を営む関連会社等に対する保有議決権割合を超えてその事業に関して責任を負うべきことを約する契約その他これに類するものがないこと。

clauses_en.text: Where all of the following requirements are satisfied for affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business
(excluding insurance companies, etc.; the same applies hereinafter in this Article)
, notwithstanding the provisions of Article 5, paragraph (2), each item of paragraph (6) through paragraph (12) of the preceding Article, and Article 10, paragraph (2),

the consolidated capital adequacy ratio may be calculated by including such affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business in the scope of consolidation in the formula of each item of Article 2 and Article 2-2, paragraph (1), using the proportional consolidation method

(meaning a method of including in the scope of consolidation the portion of a company's assets, liabilities, revenues and expenses attributable to the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. investing in such company; the same applies in the following paragraph)

In such case, the equity method shall not be applied to investments in such affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business, notwithstanding the provisions of the main text of Article 10, paragraph (1) of the Consolidated Financial Statements Regulation, and such affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business shall be deemed consolidated subsidiaries, etc.
(i) Two or more juridical persons, etc. investing in such affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business
(hereinafter referred to as "jointly controlled companies" in this paragraph)
have concluded investment and business agreements for the purpose of jointly controlling the business of such affiliated companies, etc.

(ii) The jointly controlled companies are jointly controlling and operating the business of such affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business in proportion to their voting rights holding ratio with respect to such affiliated companies, etc., based on the investment and business agreements provided in item (i).
(iii) The voting rights holding ratio of each of the jointly controlled companies with respect to such affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business is not less than 20%.

(iv) There is no contract or similar agreement in which the Ultimate Designated Parent Company having such affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business as affiliated companies, etc. agrees to be responsible for the business of such affiliated companies, etc. beyond the Ultimate Designated Parent Company's voting rights holding ratio with respect to such affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business.

children.heading: 信用リスク・アセットの額の合計額
children.heading_en: Total Amount of Credit Risk-Weighted Assets
children.summary_ja: 連結自己資本規制比率の算式における信用リスク・アセットの合計額の定義を示し、信用リスク・アセットの算出を要しない項目（個別貸倒引当金・派生商品資産・調整後控除済み資産等）と中央清算機関関連エクスポージャーの除外規定を定める条文。
children.summary_en: Defines the total credit risk-weighted assets for the consolidated capital adequacy ratio formula and specifies items exempt from credit risk-weighted asset calculation, including specific reserves, derivative assets, adjusted deducted items, and certain central counterparty exposures.

children.text_ja: 第二条各号及び第二条の二第一項の算式において信用リスク・アセットの額の合計額は、標準的手法採用最終指定親会社にあっては第十四条に定めるものを、内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社にあっては第百二十八条に定めるものをいう。
children.text_en: In the formula of each item of Article 2 and Article 2-2, paragraph (1), the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets means, in the case of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach, the amount provided in Article 14, and in the case of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach, the amount provided in Article 128.

clauses_ja.text: 第二条各号及び第二条の二第一項の算式において信用リスク・アセットの額の合計額は、標準的手法採用最終指定親会社にあっては第十四条に定めるものを、内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社にあっては第百二十八条に定めるものをいう。

clauses_en.text: In the formula of each item of Article 2 and Article 2-2, paragraph (1), the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets means, in the case of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach, the amount provided in Article 14, and in the case of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach, the amount provided in Article 128.

children.text_ja: 前項の規定にかかわらず、次に掲げるもの及び第十一条の二から第十一条の四までの規定によりトレーディング勘定に分類された商品(証券化取引を目的として保有している資産、第十一条の三第三項第四号に掲げるもの及び第二百四十八条の三の三、第二百四十八条の三の四又は第二百四十八条の四の七第一項に規定するCVAリスク相当額の算出に反映された取引を除く。)については、信用リスク・アセットの額を算出することを要しない。一個別貸倒引当金(内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社が第百二十八条第一号に規定する信用リスク・アセットの額の合計額を算出する場合にあっては、次に掲げるエクスポージャーに対して計上されているものに限る。)イ株式等エクスポージャーロ第四章第三節第九款において信用リスク・アセットの額の算出方法が規定されているその他資産等二特定海外債権引当勘定三支払承諾見返勘定四派生商品取引に係る資産五有価証券、コモディティ又は外国通貨(以下「有価証券等」という。)及びその対価の受渡し又は決済を行う取引に係る未収金六自己保有資本調達手段、対象資本等調達手段、無形固定資産(のれん相当差額を含む。)、繰延税金資産及び退職給付に係る資産のうち、第五条第二項、第六条第二項及び第七条第二項の規定により普通株式等Tier1資本に係る調整項目の額、その他Tier1資本に係る調整項目の額又はTier2資本に係る調整項目の額とされたものの額に相当する部分七第五条第四項の規定により繰延税金負債の額と相殺された額に相当する部分
children.text_en: Notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding paragraph, it is not necessary to calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets for the following items and products classified into the trading account pursuant to the provisions of Articles 11-2 through 11-4 (excluding assets held for the purpose of securitization transactions, items set forth in Article 11-3, paragraph (3), item (iv), and transactions reflected in the calculation of CVA risk equivalent amounts provided in Articles 248-3-3, 248-3-4, or 248-4-7, paragraph (1)). (i) Specific loan loss reserves (in the case of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach calculating the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets provided in Article 128, item (i), limited to those recorded against the following exposures): (a) Equity exposures; (b) Other assets, etc. for which the calculation method of credit risk-weighted assets is provided in Part IV, Chapter 3, Section 3, Subsection 9. (ii) Specific overseas loan loss reserve account. (iii) Guarantee obligations contra account. (iv) Assets relating to derivative transactions. (v) Accounts receivable relating to transactions for delivery or settlement of securities, commodities or foreign currencies (hereinafter referred to as "securities, etc.") and their consideration. (vi) Portions corresponding to amounts treated as adjustment items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital, adjustment items relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital, or adjustment items relating to Tier 2 Capital pursuant to the provisions of Article 5, paragraph (2), Article 6, paragraph (2), and Article 7, paragraph (2), among self-held capital instruments, target capital, etc. instruments, intangible fixed assets (including goodwill equivalent differences), deferred tax assets, and assets relating to retirement benefits. (vii) Portions corresponding to amounts offset against deferred tax liabilities pursuant to the provisions of Article 5, paragraph (4).

children.summary_ja: マーケット・リスク相当額の合計額は第六章に従い算出した額の合計とすることを定め、一定の現金・預金・コール資金についてトレーディング管理されているものを対象に含められる旨を規定する条文。
children.summary_en: Defines the total market risk equivalent amount as the sum calculated pursuant to Chapter 6, and allows certain cash, deposits, and call money managed as trading by trading departments to be included.

children.text_ja: 第二条各号及び第二条の二第一項の算式においてマーケット・リスク相当額の合計額は、第六章に定めるところにより算出するものの合計額とする。ただし、現金預け金、預金及びコール資金(連結子法人等における本支店間の取引を含む。)のうち、トレーディングを行う部署においてリスク管理上トレーディングとして管理及び評価をしているものについては対象に含めることができる。
children.text_en: In the formula of each item of Article 2 and Article 2-2, paragraph (1), the total amount of market risk equivalent amounts shall be the sum of amounts calculated pursuant to the provisions of Chapter 6; provided, however, that among cash deposits, deposits, and call money (including transactions between head office and branches in consolidated subsidiaries, etc.), those that are managed and evaluated as trading for risk management purposes by trading departments may be included.

clauses_ja.text: 第二条各号及び第二条の二第一項の算式においてマーケット・リスク相当額の合計額は、第六章に定めるところにより算出するものの合計額とする。

provided, however, that among cash deposits, deposits, and call money
(including transactions between head office and branches in consolidated subsidiaries, etc.)

children.summary_ja: 最終指定親会社等にトレーディング勘定とバンキング勘定の設置を義務付け、保有する商品をいずれかの勘定に分類することを求める条文。
children.summary_en: Requires Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, etc. to establish trading and banking accounts and classify all held products into one of these accounts.

children.text_ja: 最終指定親会社等は、その保有する商品を分類するためにトレーディング勘定及びバンキング勘定を設け、次条及び第十一条の四に定めるところにより、その保有する商品をいずれかの勘定に分類するものとする。
children.text_en: Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, etc. shall establish trading accounts and banking accounts for the purpose of classifying products they hold, and shall classify products they hold into one of such accounts pursuant to the provisions of the following Article and Article 11-4.

clauses_ja.text: 最終指定親会社等は、その保有する商品を分類するためにトレーディング勘定及びバンキング勘定を設け、次条及び第十一条の四に定めるところにより、その保有する商品をいずれかの勘定に分類するものとする。

clauses_en.text: Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, etc. shall establish trading accounts and banking accounts for the purpose of classifying products they hold, and shall classify products they hold into one of such accounts pursuant to the provisions of the following Article and Article 11-4.

children.heading: トレーディング勘定への分類基準等
children.heading_en: Criteria for Classification into the Trading Account, etc.
children.summary_ja: トレーディング勘定への分類基準を定め、トレーディング目的の商品・一定の非トレーディング商品（マーケット・メイク業務用・一定のファンド・上場株式・レポ取引・オプション・コリレーション取引等）をトレーディング勘定に分類し、公正価値の日次計測を義務付ける条文。
children.summary_en: Establishes criteria for trading account classification, requiring products held for trading purposes and specified non-trading products (market-making, qualifying funds, listed stocks, repo transactions, options, correlation trading, etc.) to be classified as trading and valued at fair value daily.

children.text_ja: 商品の保有の目的が次に掲げる目的(以下「トレーディング目的」という。)のいずれかに該当する商品は、トレーディング勘定に分類するものとする。一短期間の再売却目的二相場その他の指標に係る短期の価格変動からの利益の獲得目的三市場間の裁定取引による利益の獲得目的四前三号に掲げる目的のいずれかで保有している商品から生ずるリスクのヘッジ目的
children.text_en: Products whose purpose of holding falls under any of the following purposes (hereinafter referred to as "trading purposes") shall be classified into the trading account. (i) Short-term resale purpose. (ii) Purpose of obtaining profit from short-term price fluctuations relating to market prices or other indicators. (iii) Purpose of obtaining profit from arbitrage transactions between markets. (iv) Purpose of hedging risks arising from products held for any of the purposes set forth in items (i) through (iii).

clauses_ja.text: 商品の保有の目的が次に掲げる目的

children.text_ja: トレーディング商品のうち、次に掲げるもの以外は、トレーディング勘定に分類するものとする。一非上場株式二証券化のための裏付資産にする予定の商品三直接に保有する不動産四個人又は中堅中小企業(事業法人のうち、当該事業法人の売上高(当該事業法人が連結財務諸表を作成している場合にあっては、連結の売上高。以下この号において同じ。)が五十億円未満のものをいう。ただし、当該事業法人が卸売業を営む場合その他の当該事業法人の事業規模を判断するに当たって当該事業法人の売上高を用いることが適切でない場合には、当該事業法人の総資産が五十億円未満のものをこれに含めることができる。)に対する信用供与五ファンドへの出資(次項第二号に掲げるものを除く。)六前各号に掲げる商品のいずれかを原資産とする派生商品取引又はファンド七前各号に掲げる商品のリスクをヘッジする目的で保有する商品
children.text_en: Among trading products, those other than the following shall be classified into the trading account. (i) Non-listed stocks. (ii) Products planned to be underlying assets for securitization. (iii) Real estate held directly. (iv) Credit extended to individuals or medium and small-sized enterprises (meaning business corporations whose net sales (in cases where such business corporation prepares consolidated financial statements, consolidated net sales; the same applies hereinafter in this item) are less than 5 billion yen; provided, however, that in cases where such business corporation is engaged in wholesale trade or other cases where it is not appropriate to use net sales of such business corporation in judging the scale of its business, those whose total assets are less than 5 billion yen may be included). (v) Equity investments in funds (excluding those set forth in item (ii) of the following paragraph). (vi) Derivative transactions or funds for which any of the products set forth in the preceding items is an underlying asset. (vii) Products held for the purpose of hedging risks of products set forth in the preceding items.

(b) Positions where short positions of products used as hedging instruments against long positions subject to hedging are over-hedged. (iii) Products arising from underwriting business.

children.text_ja: 最終指定親会社等は、商品を売却すること及び商品のリスクをヘッジすることに関して法令に別段の定めがない限り、当該商品をトレーディング勘定に分類することができる。
children.text_en: Unless otherwise provided by laws and regulations regarding the sale of products and hedging of product risks, Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, etc. may classify such products into the trading account.

clauses_ja.text: 最終指定親会社等は、商品を売却すること及び商品のリスクをヘッジすることに関して法令に別段の定めがない限り、当該商品をトレーディング勘定に分類することができる。

clauses_en.text: Unless otherwise provided by laws and regulations regarding the sale of products and hedging of product risks, Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, etc. may classify such products into the trading account.

children.text_ja: 最終指定親会社等は、トレーディング勘定に分類する商品のうち、会計上で公正価値評価が求められているものについては、公正価値を日次で計測し、評価損益を認識するものとする。
children.text_en: Among products classified into the trading account, those for which fair value measurement is required for accounting purposes shall have their fair value measured on a daily basis and gains or losses on valuation shall be recognized by Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, etc.

clauses_ja.text: 最終指定親会社等は、トレーディング勘定に分類する商品のうち、会計上で公正価値評価が求められているものについては、公正価値を日次で計測し、評価損益を認識するものとする。

clauses_en.text: Among products classified into the trading account, those for which fair value measurement is required for accounting purposes shall have their fair value measured on a daily basis and gains or losses on valuation shall be recognized by Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, etc.

children.heading: バンキング勘定への分類基準
children.heading_en: Criteria for Classification into the Banking Account
children.summary_ja: トレーディング勘定への分類基準に該当しない商品はバンキング勘定に分類するものとし、一定のトレーディング商品をあらかじめ届け出ることでバンキング勘定に分類できる旨を規定する条文。
children.summary_en: Requires products not meeting the trading account classification criteria to be classified into the banking account, and permits certain trading products to be placed in the banking account upon prior notification.

children.text_ja: 前条の規定によりトレーディング勘定に分類する商品以外の商品は、バンキング勘定に分類するものとする。
children.text_en: Products other than those classified into the trading account pursuant to the provisions of the preceding Article shall be classified into the banking account.

clauses_ja.text: 前条の規定によりトレーディング勘定に分類する商品以外の商品は、バンキング勘定に分類するものとする。

clauses_en.text: Products other than those classified into the trading account pursuant to the provisions of the preceding Article shall be classified into the banking account.

children.text_ja: トレーディング商品及び前条第三項の規定によりトレーディング勘定に分類することとされる商品のうち、トレーディング目的以外の目的で保有するものについては、あらかじめ金融庁長官に届け出た場合に限り、バンキング勘定に分類することができる。
children.text_en: Among trading products and products to be classified into the trading account pursuant to the provisions of Article 11-3, paragraph (3), those held for purposes other than trading purposes may be classified into the banking account only where prior notice has been given to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency.

clauses_ja.text: トレーディング商品及び前条第三項の規定によりトレーディング勘定に分類することとされる商品のうち、トレーディング目的以外の目的で保有するものについては、あらかじめ金融庁長官に届け出た場合に限り、
バンキング勘定に分類することができる。

clauses_en.text: Among trading products and products to be classified into the trading account pursuant to the provisions of Article 11-3, paragraph (3), those held for purposes other than trading purposes may be classified into the banking account only where prior notice has been given to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency.

children.heading: 商品分類に係る方針等
children.summary_ja: 商品分類に関する方針・手続き文書の作成とその遵守態勢の確立を義務付け、マーケット・リスク管理部署による検証体制の整備と内部監査部署による年1回以上の監査実施を求める条文。
children.summary_en: Requires Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, etc. to document trading account classification policies, establish compliance systems, maintain a verification framework in the market risk management department, and conduct internal audits at least annually.

children.text_ja: 最終指定親会社等は、トレーディング勘定に分類する商品の範囲を定めるための方針及び手続に係る文書を作成するとともにその遵守態勢を確立するものとする。
children.text_en: Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, etc. shall prepare documentation relating to policies and procedures for determining the scope of products classified into the trading account and shall establish a system for compliance therewith.

clauses_ja.text: 最終指定親会社等は、トレーディング勘定に分類する商品の範囲を定めるための方針及び手続に係る文書を作成するとともにその遵守態勢を確立するものとする。

clauses_en.text: Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, etc. shall prepare documentation relating to policies and procedures for determining the scope of products classified into the trading account and shall establish a system for compliance therewith.

children.text_ja: 最終指定親会社等のフロント・オフィス部門から独立したマーケット・リスクの管理に責任を負う部署(以下「マーケット・リスク管理部署」という。)は、前項の商品の分類が適切に実施されたかどうかの検証をする体制を整備するものとする。
children.text_en: The department responsible for market risk management that is independent from the front office of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the "Market Risk Management Department") shall establish a system for verifying whether the product classification set forth in the preceding paragraph has been appropriately implemented.

clauses_ja.text: 最終指定親会社等のフロント・オフィス部門から独立したマーケット・リスクの管理に責任を負う部署
(以下「マーケット・リスク管理部署」という。)
は、前項の商品の分類が適切に実施されたかどうかの検証をする体制を整備するものとする。

clauses_en.text: The department responsible for market risk management that is independent from the front office of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc.
(hereinafter referred to as the "Market Risk Management Department")
shall establish a system for verifying whether the product classification set forth in the preceding paragraph has been appropriately implemented.

defined_terms.term_ja: マーケット・リスク管理部署

children.text_ja: 最終指定親会社等の内部監査部署は、第一項の商品の分類に係る内部監査を一年に一回以上実施し、その結果を金融庁長官の求めに応じて提出することができるように整備するものとする。
children.text_en: The internal audit department of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. shall conduct internal audits relating to the product classification set forth in paragraph (1) at least once per year and shall establish a system so that the results thereof can be submitted in response to a request from the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency.

clauses_ja.text: 最終指定親会社等の内部監査部署は、第一項の商品の分類に係る内部監査を一年に一回以上実施し、その結果を金融庁長官の求めに応じて提出することができるように整備するものとする。

clauses_en.text: The internal audit department of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. shall conduct internal audits relating to the product classification set forth in paragraph (1) at least once per year and shall establish a system so that the results thereof can be submitted in response to a request from the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency.

children.heading: 勘定間の振替の制限
children.summary_ja: 原則として勘定間の振替（トレーディング勘定とバンキング勘定間の商品の移し替え）を禁止し、取締役承認・内部監査・開示の3要件を満たす場合にのみ金融庁長官への事前届出により例外的に認める条文。
children.summary_en: Prohibits transfers between the trading and banking accounts as a general rule, permitting exceptions only when board approval, internal audit, and disclosure requirements are all met, subject to prior notification to the Commissioner of the FSA.

children.text_ja: 最終指定親会社等は、次に掲げる行為(以下この条から第十一条の八までにおいて「勘定間の振替」という。)を行ってはならない。一トレーディング勘定に分類した商品をバンキング勘定に移し替えること。二バンキング勘定に分類した商品をトレーディング勘定に移し替えること。
children.text_en: Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, etc. shall not engage in the following acts (hereinafter referred to as "transfers between accounts" in this Article through Article 11-8). (i) Reclassifying products classified into the trading account into the banking account. (ii) Reclassifying products classified into the banking account into the trading account.

clauses_ja.text: 最終指定親会社等は、次に掲げる行為
(以下この条から第十一条の八までにおいて「勘定間の振替」という。)
を行ってはならない。
一トレーディング勘定に分類した商品をバンキング勘定に移し替えること。
二バンキング勘定に分類した商品をトレーディング勘定に移し替えること。

clauses_en.text: Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, etc. shall not engage in the following acts
(hereinafter referred to as "transfers between accounts" in this Article through Article 11-8)
(i) Reclassifying products classified into the trading account into the banking account.
(ii) Reclassifying products classified into the banking account into the trading account.

children.text_ja: 前項の規定にかかわらず、最終指定親会社等は、次に掲げる要件の全てを満たす場合には、勘定間の振替を行うことができる。一当該勘定間の振替について取締役等の承認を受けていること。二当該勘定間の振替について内部監査が行われていること。三当該勘定間の振替について開示すること。
children.text_en: Notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding paragraph, Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, etc. may make transfers between accounts when all of the following requirements are satisfied. (i) Approval of directors, etc. has been obtained for such transfer between accounts. (ii) Internal audit has been conducted for such transfer between accounts. (iii) Disclosure of such transfer between accounts is made.

clauses_ja.text: 前項の規定にかかわらず、最終指定親会社等は、次に掲げる要件の全てを満たす場合には、勘定間の振替を行うことができる。
一当該勘定間の振替について取締役等の承認を受けていること。
二当該勘定間の振替について内部監査が行われていること。
三当該勘定間の振替について開示すること。

clauses_en.text: Notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding paragraph, Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, etc. may make transfers between accounts when all of the following requirements are satisfied.
(i) Approval of directors, etc. has been obtained for such transfer between accounts.
(ii) Internal audit has been conducted for such transfer between accounts.
(iii) Disclosure of such transfer between accounts is made.

children.text_ja: 最終指定親会社等は、前項の規定により勘定間の振替を行う場合には、あらかじめ、その旨及び次に掲げる事項を記載した届出書を金融庁長官に提出するものとする。一勘定間の振替を行う商品の種類(当該商品が第十一条の三第三項第一号から第三号までに掲げる商品のいずれかに該当するときは、その旨を含む。)二前項各号に掲げる要件の全てを満たしている旨の説明三勘定間の振替を行う商品の保有の目的の変更に係る説明四その他参考となるべき事項
children.text_en: When Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, etc. make transfers between accounts pursuant to the provisions of the preceding paragraph, they shall in advance submit to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency a notification containing such fact and the following matters. (i) The type of product for which the transfer between accounts is made (including, where such product falls under any of the products set forth in Article 11-3, paragraph (3), items (i) through (iii), such fact). (ii) An explanation that all of the requirements set forth in each item of the preceding paragraph are satisfied. (iii) An explanation relating to the change in the purpose of holding the product for which the transfer between accounts is made. (iv) Other matters that may serve as reference.
